web.title: I am Elise — Lean on me, when all your other friends are asleep.
web.intro: Elise is a demonstration of the Praxeon actor model — an LLM-powered assistant exploring how a clinical *intake* conversation might help prepare for a new visit. This is demoware, not a real clinical setting. Elise is not a clinician; she does not diagnose, prescribe, or give medical advice, and she is no substitute for professional care. The visit is fictitious — please don't share real personal or health information.
web.disclaimer: Demoware — not a real clinical setting. Not therapy or medical advice. The visit is fictitious; please don't enter real personal or health information.

web.crisis: If you're in immediate danger or thinking about harming yourself, please reach out right now to local emergency services, or a crisis line such as 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US). You deserve support from a real person, and talking to someone can help.
